See a look online? Right-click it.

Right-click any photo on any site and choose "Find with AI". Your results open right beside the page.

Coming soon to the Chrome Web Store
Desktop Chrome, Edge and Brave
1
Add to Chrome

From the Chrome Web Store as soon as it's listed.

2
Right-click a photo

Choose "Find with AI" from the menu.

3
Shop or sew

Results open in a side panel next to the page.

What the extension can access
Right-click menu
Adds "Find with AI" when you right-click an image.
Side panel
Shows your results next to the page you're on.
The image you clicked
Only that one image, only when you choose "Find with AI". If the site blocks direct downloads, the extension copies the image from the page instead.
Storage
Remembers your visitor ID and sign-in on this browser.
Sign-in
Opens the Outfit Finder sign-in page in a pop-up window.

It never reads pages you don't right-click, and it doesn't track your browsing.

title: Privacy Policy · Outfit Finder
text:
Skip to content

Outfit Finder
Privacy Policy
Privacy
Terms
Cookies
Report content
Version 1.0, effective 1 December 2026. Draft text: final wording needs legal review.
What we collect

The photos you upload, the clothing results we find, your username, your email address if you choose to give one, and body measurements if you choose to add them. If you accept our cookie, we also keep a random visitor ID so your looks are remembered on this device.

How photos are handled

Each photo is first checked for unsafe content by Microsoft Azure AI Content Safety. It is then sent to our AI provider (OpenAI) to find the clothing and where to buy it. Faces are blurred, and only the blurred copy is saved. The original upload is deleted as soon as the search finishes. Photos that fail the safety check are never stored; we keep only a fingerprint (hash) and the reason, to stop repeat uploads.

How long we keep it

Photos and results are deleted after 90 days. You can delete any search, or everything, at any time from Account & privacy.

Who processes your data

Microsoft Azure hosts the service. OpenAI analyses photos. Microsoft Azure AI Content Safety checks photos for unsafe content. We do not sell your data and we do not show ads.

Your rights

You can download your data, correct it, or delete your account and everything in it from Account & privacy. You can also contact us at privacy@example.com. If you are in the EU or UK you may

Version 1.0, effective 1 December 2026. Draft text: final wording needs legal review.
Who can use it

You must be 16 or older to use Outfit Finder.

Photos you upload

Only upload photos you have the right to use. No photos of children, and no explicit or illegal content. Repeated attempts to upload unsafe content will block uploads from your device.

Results

Matches, prices and stock come from other websites and can be wrong or out of date. Check with the store before you buy. We are not the seller and are not responsible for third-party stores.

Patterns

Patterns are drafted in the style of a garment for personal use. They are not copies of the original design. Logos and branded prints are never included.

Misuse

We can suspend accounts that break these terms. Report a problem or ask for content to be removed using the takedown form, or email abuse@example.com.

The cookies we use

One cookie (gf_visitor) remembers your looks on this device, and only after you accept it. When you sign in, one more cookie keeps you signed in. A tiny setting in your browser remembers light or dark mode. That is all.

What we do not use

No advertising cookies and no third-party tracking.

Your choice

Privacy Policy
Privacy

Version 1.0, effective 1 December 2026. Draft text: final wording needs legal review.
What we collect

The photos you upload, the clothing results we find, your username, your email address if you choose to give one, and body measurements if you choose to add them. If you accept our cookie, we also keep a random visitor ID so your looks are remembered on this device.

How photos are handled

Each photo is first checked for unsafe content by Microsoft Azure AI Content Safety. It is then sent to our AI provider (OpenAI) to find the clothing and where to buy it. Faces are blurred, and only the blurred copy is saved. The original upload is deleted as soon as the search finishes. Photos that fail the safety check are never stored; we keep only a fingerprint (hash) and the reason, to stop repeat uploads.

How long we keep it

Photos and results are deleted after 90 days. You can delete any search, or everything, at any time from Account & privacy.

Who processes your data

Microsoft Azure hosts the service. OpenAI analyses photos. Microsoft Azure AI Content Safety checks photos for unsafe content. We do not sell your data and we do not show ads.

How to measure

Use a soft tape measure over thin clothing. Keep it snug but not tight.

Bust / chest
Around the fullest part of the chest, under the arms, tape level across the back.
Waist
Around your natural waist, the narrowest part above the belly button.
Hip
Around the fullest part of the hips and bottom, feet together.
Neck
Around the base of the neck, where a collar sits.
Shoulder width
Across the back from the tip of one shoulder bone to the other.
Back waist length
From the bump at the base of the neck down the spine to the waist.
Upper arm
Around the fullest part of the upper arm, arm relaxed.
Crotch depth
Sit on a flat chair; measure from the waist at your side straight down to the seat.
Inseam
From the crotch down the inside of the leg to the floor, without shoes.
